scope: Two active UI files: confirmation roster inline; existing participant rows and guest recovery reused.
details: All invitation records remain visible without a selected filter. Existing selected-and-accepted count and all reply/publish/calendar predicates/requests stay.
Confirmation no longer owns a people-open state/button/sheet. Inline and sheet share one invitationRows expression.
Collecting-avatar entry and old collecting sheet remain. Owner-only old guest recovery entry, native confirmation/share and state stay.
No new business state, request, component or dependency; only UI presentation parameter and view composition.
execution: Actual final phone/API/pixel acceptance recorded separately; static review is not physical old-guest-recovery or all-state execution.
